exposure: urinary tract infection in pregnant women in the third trimester of pregnancy
cohort: 2,371 neonates born to Peruvian military personnel between 2009 and 2017
finding: Longer neonatal hospital stay, greater gestational age, and development of urinary tract infection in pregnant women in the third trimester of pregnancy were associated with increased frequency of early-onset neonatal sepsis, while female neonates had lower incidence.
